description: This shell script is responsible for managing log backups, system reboots, and associated bookkeeping tasks in a device running RDK-based firmware. It includes functions for copying logs, handling reboot notifications, syncing logs with remote servers, and managing process IDs to prevent duplicate executions.

methods.name: backup_log_pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file to clean up after log upload processes.

methods.name: getTFTPServer
methods.description: Determines the TFTP server based on input parameter and configuration file.

methods.name: Trigger_RebootPendingNotify
methods.description: Sets a reboot pending notification before device reboot, using dmcli.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Parses /version.txt to determine build type: DEV, VBN, PROD, or CQA.

methods.name: backupLogsonReboot
methods.description: Captures current logs, system descriptors, and backs them up to a specified directory before reboot.

methods.name: backupLogsonReboot_nvram2
methods.description: Performs a similar log backup as backupLogsonReboot but tailored for NVRAM2 supported devices, including additional steps for telemetry and log handling.
